name: Dr. KANNADASAN K
position: Assistant Professor — Dept. of CSE, IIITDM Kancheepuram
description: Dr. Kannadasan K is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM) Kancheepuram, Chennai. He received his B.Tech. in Information Technology from SASTRA University, M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering from NIT Goa, and Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from NIT Tiruchirappalli. He was a Prime Minister's Research Fellow during his doctoral studies. His research interests include Brain-Computer Interfaces, EEG Signal Processing, Affective Computing, and Machine Learning. His research focuses on developing intelligent systems using brain and physiological signals, with applications in human cognition, emotion, and healthcare. He is also involved in interdisciplinary research on immersive VR and biofeedback-based systems for mental health applications.
